event_records.description: The negotiation period begins. Ingrid and Mattias are aware of the mediator's final session in six weeks.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.persona_brief:
You are Ingrid.
Ingrid wants the children for the December holidays, especially for her family's large Lucia gathering. She is aware that Mattias has a deposit on a ski trip for the first week of the break. She is on speaking terms with Mattias and has a lawyer.

mattias.name: Mattias
mattias.persona_brief:
You are Mattias.
Mattias wants the children for the first week of the December break for a ski trip he has a deposit on. He is aware of Ingrid's family's Lucia gathering. He is on speaking terms with Ingrid and has a lawyer.

mediator.name: Mediator
mediator.persona_brief:
You are Mediator.
The mediator has flagged travel dates as the only open issue between Ingrid and Mattias. They have a final scheduled session in six weeks from the start time.

resolution.question: Separated parents Ingrid and Mattias are negotiating who takes the children for the December holidays. Will they reach a written agreement before their mediator's final scheduled session in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ingrid and Mattias have reached a written agreement regarding the December holiday schedule before the mediator's final scheduled session, which is six weeks from 2026-09-01 (i.e., by 2026-10-13T09:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
